mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS level below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE above 5.5% indicates strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not higher than baseline when UNRATE crosses above 5.5%

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive returns.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher when both proxies rise concurrently

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in FEDFUNDS signals effective monetary policy easing, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity values, driving positive returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases while FEDFUNDS decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: 20d returns not higher when the pair forms this pattern

mechanism_narrative: Declining UNRATE and falling PAYEMS indicate weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines in the same month
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative when both fall

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regime, rising PAYEMS signals peak employment, triggering profit-taking and negative returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative in > 60% of late-cycle instances

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 grows for 3 months

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL >6%) erodes real returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 6%
